properties.global_prompt:

Sound follows its physical source and distance.

One continuous 15-second live-action shot. Begin directly from the supplied image. Tight shoulder-up close two-shot of father and elder beside the family cistern, faces large and equally sharp on the same focal plane. Elder's neck and jaw tense under the water-jar rope load below crop, the top of the rope rising at bottom edge. Father watches his son with concern, prepared to offer help; sunlit cistern masonry is softly recognizable behind. Single photorealistic live-action first-century eastern Mediterranean film still, 2.39:1 anamorphic composition; natural skin texture, real fabric and light, no text, collage, labels, fantasy or modern items.
